# Security policy

solarityai.com is a static site generated from this repository and served by Cloudflare Pages. It has no server code, database or login. Contact on the site is by direct email and booking links. The careers form posts to FormSubmit.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Solarity-AI/solarityai-landing-page/security/advisories/new), or email ata.turhan@solarityai.com. Please don't open a public issue.

Include the affected page or file, what an attacker could do, and the steps to reproduce it. You will get a reply within five working days.

The web apps (Engineering Max, Management Max and Marketing Max) and the mobile apps are separate products with their own code. Report issues in them through their own support addresses, or through the same email.
